event: Government amends PP 42/2024, postponing mandatory halal certification for certain products from 17 Oct 2026 to 17 Oct 2028; Apindo and Kadin welcome the delay.
key_numbers: Old deadline 17 Oct 2026 · new deadline 17 Oct 2028 · announced 16 Oct by Susiwijono Moegiarso · foreign halal verification rules revoked

event: Singapore's NEA names seven companies managing Sumatra forest concessions as linked to haze fires; three supply Asia Pulp & Paper, and Kencana Agri reports 62 ha burned in Kalimantan concessions while denying it started the fire.
key_numbers: 7 companies (Bumi Andalas Permai, Bumi Mekar Hijau, Paramitra Mulia Langgeng, Sumatera Alam Anugerah, SBA Wood Industries, Hutan Lestari Raya, Bangkanesia) · 3 APP suppliers · Kencana Agri 62 ha · ISPA 283,270 cases (13 Oct)

event: Ministry of Cooperatives proposes paying PNS salaries and pensions through Koperasi Desa/Kelurahan Merah Putih; the plan is with the Finance Ministry and no government decision exists yet.
key_numbers: Proposal submitted to Kemenkeu (Minister Ferry Juliantono, 15 Oct) · cooperatives would add to, not replace, banks and BPD · no amounts or timeline

event: Bank Indonesia's Q3 2026 business survey shows positive activity in all sectors and capacity utilisation steady at 73.75%.
key_numbers: SBT activity +11.46% · next-quarter SBT +10.77% · capacity utilisation 73.75% · credit access easy

event: Disclosure shows Haji Isam-linked companies pledged 100% stakes in PGUN and JARR shares as collateral for Bank Mandiri credit to PT Jhonlin Baratama.
key_numbers: Pledges 28 Sep (PGUN) and 30 Sep (JARR) · PGUN: 2,205,667,896 + 2,194,718,786 + 900,000,250 shares · JARR: 7,997,556,204 shares · loan amount not disclosed · funds coal capex

event: Kemenhub reports forest-fire smoke has disrupted 2,458 domestic flights at 29 airports since 11 Aug, up from 2,021 on 13 Oct. (update of E0021)
key_numbers: 2,458 domestic flights affected (1,080 delayed · 1,324 cancelled/postponed · 22 diverted) · 29 airports · +437 since 13 Oct · 14 international flights cancelled (Singapore–Pontianak/Palembang) · 22 perintis flights cancelled 16 Oct · period 11 Aug–17 Oct 2026

event: BMKG satellite shows forest-fire smoke from Kalimantan and Sumatra reaching Banten, West Java and Jakarta; Governor Pramono puts Jakarta hospitals and puskesmas on standby. (update of E0021)
key_numbers: 31 hospitals · 44 puskesmas · 292 puskesmas pembantu on standby · BMKG image released 16 Oct 10:00 · air quality worse for 2-3 days (Pramono) · BMKG: satellite smoke does not equal ground-level PM2.5; Liputan6 18 Oct: Jakarta air still unhealthy in some areas though smoke moving away

event: Malaysian PM Anwar Ibrahim says Indonesian haze has harmed health and closed schools in some Malaysian states, proposes an ASEAN haze mechanism and offers help. (update of E0021)
key_numbers: 'tens of thousands' of Indonesian personnel deployed (Anwar) · school closures in some Malaysian states (no count)

event: MUI Deputy Chair Cholil Nafis calls the fires at 'emergency' level, urges Prabowo to prioritise them and asks for firm law enforcement against land burners, citing MUI Fatwa 30/2016 (burning forests is haram).
key_numbers: Fatwa No. 30/2016 · statement dated 19 Oct

event: CELIOS estimates Jan–Aug 2026 karhutla losses of Rp39.29–123.1 T depending on how health costs are counted; BNPB still fighting 639.23 ha in six priority provinces as of 13 Oct. (update of E0021)
key_numbers: Total Rp39.29–123.1 T · physical/economic Rp29.54 T · ISPA health cost Rp9.75 T (diagnosed, ~1.78 M people) to Rp93.56 T (broad) · Central Kalimantan loss ≈49.1% of its 2026 PDRB · regional tax revenue risk up to Rp269.86 miliar · ~202,010 ha burned nationally (Aug data) · 639.23 ha active, Tanjung Puting 513.89 ha

event: BRIN researcher explains why peat and forest fires are so hard to put out: underground smouldering, limited water bombing, smoke blocking aerial work; recommends keeping peat wet and holding concession holders accountable.
key_numbers: Source: Yayan Hadiyan, BRIN Pusat Riset Ekologi

event: Anak Krakatau erupts 8 times on 18 Oct, ash up to 500 m; stays at Level III (Siaga). (update of E0010)
key_numbers: 8 eruptions · ash 100–500 m above summit (657 m asl) · no entry within 5 km, 1 km of new islands

event: Government postpones mandatory halal certification phases that were due 18 Oct 2026, to 2028 for most food, beverage and consumer products (revision of PP 42/2024).
key_numbers: Food/beverage/slaughter services: 18 Oct 2028 · micro-small businesses: 17 Oct 2028 · cosmetics, herbal, supplements etc.: 17 Oct 2028 · OTC drugs: 17 Oct 2029 · prescription drugs: 17 Oct 2034 · BPJPH Reg 4/2026 on foreign products to be revoked

event: Bharada Valdo is shot and stabbed to death at Polairud HQ, Pondok Cabe, South Tangerang; fellow Bharada Andika Rahmadani is detained; on 19 Oct Menko Polkam Dudung says Polri recruitment and psychological screening will be evaluated and Komisi III urges mental tests for armed officers.
key_numbers: Incident 16 Oct ~04:40 WIB · motive unconfirmed (alleged bullying per initial report/family lawyer; family suspects premeditation) · Polda Metro Jaya investigating

event: Former Polri international relations chief Irjen (Purn) Napoleon Bonaparte dies of illness; buried in Cikeas on 19 Oct.
key_numbers: Died 18 Oct 10:32 WIB · convicted 2021 in Djoko Tjandra Interpol red-notice bribery case, 4 years · paroled Apr 2023

event: Detik reports lawyer Kamaruddin Simanjuntak (known for the Ferdy Sambo case) has died after illness involving repeated dialysis hospital visits.
key_numbers: Detik 'terpopuler' #1 and #2 on 19 Oct (~11:30–13:30 WIB); family earlier denied a death rumour (undated)
sources: Detik terpopuler list (headlines only) <https://www.detik.com/terpopuler> ; Babel Insight (earlier rumour denied) <https://www.babelinsight.id/keluarga-bantah-rumor-kamaruddin-simanjuntak-meninggal>

event: East Jakarta court hears interlocutory ruling in Roy Suryo's slander/ITE trial over Jokowi's diploma; Detik headline says the defence objection (nota perlawanan/eksepsi) was rejected and Roy Suryo asked Jokowi to show the original diploma at trial.
key_numbers: Hearing 19 Oct 09:00 WIB, PN Jakarta Timur · charges: fitnah, pencemaran nama baik, ITE · prosecution called 'fake 99.9%' claim a matter for trial
sources: RCTI+/Okezone (hearing set) <https://www.rctiplus.com/news/detail/okezone/5487021/sidang-putusan-sela-roy-suryo-di-kasus-ijazah-jokowi-digelar-senin-19-oktober> ; Detik terpopuler list (headlines only) <https://www.detik.com/terpopuler>

event: Komisi II DPR member Ahmad Doli Kurnia says Komisi II will review the alleged 'pasal selundupan' in PKPU 19/2023 (Pasal 18(3)) that exempts candidates with a university degree from showing a foreign high-school diploma; critics link it to Gibran's 2024 candidacy. (update of E0044)
key_numbers: PKPU 19/2023 Pasal 18(3) and 13(1)r · UU 7/2017 Pasal 169r · remarks 18 Oct; MK hearing 1 Oct; ex-KPU chair Hasyim Asy'ari denies engineering

event: KPK probes the role of Klaten regent Hamenang Wajar Ismoyo's younger brother, who kept a blue barrel with Rp934 juta; funds allegedly mix procurement bribes, OPD/BUMD gratuities and quarry income; BPK Central Java audit-fixing cluster. (update of E0048)
key_numbers: Rp934 juta in barrel · ~Rp1.9 miliar total cash seized · two other suspects · regent detained 16 Oct · May 2026 BPK audit report allegedly omitted findings

event: Cek Fakta Liputan6: viral claim that Prabowo is closing the MBG free-meal programme due to an economic crisis is a hoax; the fake Kompas headline does not exist and BGN has made no such announcement.
key_numbers: Facebook post 18 Oct · Finance Minister Suahasil 9 Oct: efficiency, not budget cut · other recent hoaxes: Pertalite price to Rp13,500 (24 Sep post), 'Pertalite sachet powder' (13 Oct), fake Jasa Marga job link
sources: Liputan6 Cek Fakta (MBG) <https://www.liputan6.com/cek-fakta/read/8316202/cek-fakta-hoaks-artikel-presiden-prabowo-akan-tutup-program-mbg-karena-krisis-ekonomi> ; Liputan6 Cek Fakta (Pertalite) <https://www.liputan6.com/cek-fakta/read/8316124/kumpulan-hoaks-seputar-pertalite-simak-daftarnya>
